name: 5G Test Meeting Extraction
prompt: From the calendar file calendar_extraction_task/work_calendar_2023.ics on the desktop, filter out all meetings this year that are related to 5G core network testing. Criteria: the meeting title or description must contain both the words “5G” and “测试”; if either one is missing, it does not count. Directly remove meetings whose status is CANCELLED. Generate a Markdown document from the filtered results and save it in the same folder, with the file name 5G_Test_Meetings_Summary.md. Group the document by month, using the “YYYY年MM月” format for level-2 headings, for example ## 2023年03月. Under each month, use an unordered list to list every meeting of that month, and each entry must include the meeting's specific time range, meeting subject, and location.
